reviews.title: 120mm×25mm Id cooling daisy chain fans
reviews.comment: 120mm Common size.  Noise level is about whisper quiet.  The look, quality coolness is about on par with arctic p12 but idcooling daisy chain makes cable management better!  The speed and functionality is perfect yet still save money.  I have bought idcooling many times before.  The rubber pads on the corners do help with vibration dampening. I installed it with rubber screws just in case to tear the computer quicker.  Brightness if you do consider to buy idcooling fans, etc like I did.  Their frostflow 280mm radiator is a perfect dream if your case can support it. The price to performance is best with these.  Yes, I do own arctic p12, p14 in my first gaming computer that is not pictured.  These id cooling fans are in an old recycled logisys 2014 mid tower case.

reviews.title: Good value - expect some noise if revved to 2k rpm
reviews.comment: Great value fans that are not quiet at 2k rpm, but whisper quiet at 900 rpm, where they stay most of the time for me. I have had all three running in the front of a Corsair 4000D Airflow case continuously for the last 5 months, with a several experiences with them running full tilt for 10 minutes while I ran Cinebench, and no issues to report with any of them. Well, except the noise to be expected when a 120mm fan runs at 2k rpm. The daisy chaining feature is very useful; it helped me to achieve a clean looking cable management scenario.
reviews.author: Jonathan Brandon

reviews.title: Good fans but different
reviews.comment: The daisy chain allows easy access for limited connection on the motherboard. The screws are another story due to the threading. There is no set thread for the fans so screwing can be a bit difficult. It's like you are making the threading for the screw to set in. Other than that, good fans for being 120mm and quiet.
